title: Agentic Ticket Workflow
summary: An LLM agent that resolves support tickets — where business rules, not the model, have the final word.
problem: LLM agents happily take actions that break refund limits and policy, retry into duplicate side effects and trust whatever the ticket text says.
solution: A durable Temporal workflow: the agent decides via tool calling, Python rules check the decision, risky actions wait for a human, then the system acts — with retries that never repeat a side effect.
result: Guardrails are enforced in code and covered by tests in CI; compared a frontier model with a local 4B model on the same scenarios.
highlights: Ticket text treated as untrusted input; tools scoped to the ticket's own customer
Tool-loop limit and deterministic rules with final authority
Refunds only after explicit human approval
pytest suite and GitHub Actions CI for the guardrails
